capabilities: Reorder list items by dragging a hover handle
Move nested children together with their parent item
Configure handle position and offset in settings
extras: Works in Live Preview on desktop only; not available in other editor modes or mobile.
problem: Obsidian's editor has no way to reorder list items by dragging; users must cut and paste or edit text manually to move bullets.
summary: Drag-and-drop list reorderer that lets users move list items in the editor via a hover grip handle, keeping nested children together.
